
## How is a Web Server
is the software (or machine) that **receives requests from a browser and sends back a website**. Also it utilize HTTP protocol to deliver web content.

**Common webserver:** Apache, Nginx, and NodeJS.


## Virtual Host
It allows web server to host multiple websites using same server (IP and hardware)


## Static Vs Dynamic Content

**Static content**: fixed files served directly to users

**Dynamic content**: content generated by server logic based on data or user actions

Those changes is what we called **Backend** because it works behind the back on the website through the use of programming languages

## Backend and Frontend
This two are the main parts of the website

**Front-end** = what users see and interact with

**Back-end** = what happens behind the scenes.
